summary: Add CI publish for the static website: nex-website-publish wrapper, host bootstrap sudoers, and Website workflows that build and publish on main when website sources change. API impact: none — static site and hosting tooling only.

guide.reason: Maintainers publish the static site through CI or nex-website-publish; operate-website and publish-a-release document the split from ISO/APT release publication.

api.reason: No Controller or Core API; static website hosting and CI deploy only.

roadmap.reason: Hosting automation only; no milestone status change.

state.reason: Website artifacts and CI secrets; no pool or Controller durable state.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_nex_website_publish.py' -v; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_website_release.py' -v; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. Host bootstrap installed nex-website-publish with passwordless sudo for the publishing account. A live publish of the current website/build as release 20260917-ce0c83c3a33b returned HTTP 200 on the private backend and on the public site with expected Nex copy.
